create_predictionFormatter: create a predictionFormatter instance to format HMTL model predictions for NER, EMD, relations, and coreference
format_predictions: format HMTL model predictions with tokenized text, char offsets, and input text into structured entity and relation dicts
expand_relations: expand relation predictions using noun chunks from a spaCy doc to get full argument spans instead of just head tokens
expand_emd: expand entity mention predictions using noun chunks from a spaCy doc to get full mention spans instead of just head tokens
expand_predictions: expand both relation and entity mention predictions using noun chunks from a spaCy doc in a single call
